verdict.rationale: Bitwarden has organization vaults with collections, members and groups, which the Public API manages (bitwarden-docs-8, bitwarden-docs-11). Logins carry integrated TOTP generation (bitwarden-docs-1). A paying team user names 'safer account sharing, including 2FA' as their killer feature (bitwarden-comm-8). Missing for 10: first-party docs on per-collection permission levels (e.g. read-only or hide-password) for individual members, and explicit docs that shared organization items keep their TOTP codes.
